title: Senior Quality Engineer L1
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Associate, Quality Engineering - Level 1**
Publicis Sapient is looking for a Senior associate in quality engineering with strong functional and manual testing experience to help deliver high-quality technology solutions for our clients. You will apply your knowledge of capital markets, testing practices, APIs, and databases to validate complex trading applications across the development lifecycle. You will collaborate with developers, business stakeholders, and other quality engineers to identify risks, resolve defects, and improve product quality. Your testing expertise and problem-solving skills will contribute to reliable solutions that create meaningful value for our clients.
  
  
**Your Impact:**

* Plan and execute functional, manual, regression, and progression testing to ensure the quality and reliability of complex applications.
* Validate capital-markets workflows across the trading lifecycle, including order creation, execution, settlement, and related lifecycle events.
* Design comprehensive test scenarios covering Equities and Fixed Income instruments, including Bonds, Bond Forwards, Futures, and Swaps.
* Test REST and SOAP APIs by validating contracts, requests, responses, business fields, and error scenarios using tools such as Postman or curl.
* Write and execute SQL queries independently to validate application and test data across relevant database tables.
* Manage defects through their complete lifecycle, participate in defect triage, analyse application logs, and support root-cause investigation.
* Collaborate with developers, traders, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment to complete testing activities and support successful releases.

**Qualifications**
**Your Skills & Experience**
**:**

* 4+ years of hands-on functional or manual testing experience, preferably involving capital-markets or trading applications.
* Practical knowledge of the capital-markets trading lifecycle and experience testing Equities and Fixed Income products.
* Strong understanding of test planning, test-case design, estimation, regression testing, defect management, and test metrics.
* Working knowledge of REST and SOAP API testing, including request and response validation using Postman, curl, or similar tools.
* Ability to independently write SQL queries using SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, and GROUP BY.
* Experience working in Agile or Scrum teams and participating in relevant sprint ceremonies.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work independently and drive assigned activities to completion.

**Additional Information**
**Set Yourself Apart With**
**:**

* Experience working with front-office or middle-office applications within an Asset Management organization.
* Exposure to test automation using Selenium with Java or Robot Framework with Python.
* Python scripting experience for test utilities, data validation, or simple automation.
* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar solutions for test-case generation or defect analysis.

**Benefits of Working Here:**

* Gender-Neutral Policy
* 18 paid holidays throughout the year.
* Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
* Flexible work arrangements
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well-being.

**A Tip from the Hiring Manager:**
*“Bring strong testing fundamentals, curiosity about capital markets, and the confidence to independently investigate complex issues.”*
**Company Description**
Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally-enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

title: AVP - Journey Excellence and Transformation
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as
**“AVP - Journey Excellence and Transformation”**
at Barclays, where you’ll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You’ll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
You will join the Business Banking transformation team, which shapes future-state operating models and redesigns end-to-end customer and colleague journeys. Working across Operations, Product, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Customer Experience, the team turns strategic designs into practical transformation roadmaps that simplify processes, strengthen controls and enable sustainable digital change.
  
  
**Skills**
To be successful in this role as a “AVP - Journey Excellence and Transformation”, you should possess the following skillsets:
  
  
**Target Operating Model Design**

* Lead the development and evolution of Target Operating Models across Business Banking customer and operational journeys.
* Conduct current-state assessments to understand existing processes, customer and colleague pain points, operating structures, technology dependencies, controls and performance.
* Define future-state operating-model components across people, process, technology, data, controls, governance and performance management.
* Develop clear design principles to guide future-state structures, service models and ways of working.
* Define roles, responsibilities, capabilities, interaction models, governance arrangements and decision rights required to support the target state.
* Ensure proposed operating models are practical, scalable and aligned with Business Banking priorities, customer needs and applicable regulatory expectations.
* Maintain traceability between identified business problems, design decisions, proposed changes and intended outcomes.

**Customer and Colleague Journey Transformation**

* Lead the assessment and redesign of end-to-end customer and colleague journeys across areas such as onboarding, servicing, lending, Customer Due Diligence and case management.
* Apply customer-centred design principles to simplify journeys, reduce avoidable friction and improve customer and colleague outcomes.
* Facilitate journey-mapping and design workshops with operational teams, subject-matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Identify process gaps, failure points, unnecessary hand-offs, duplication, delays and control weaknesses.
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable and digitally enabled future-state journeys.
* Ensure journey designs appropriately consider different customer needs, servicing requirements and risk profiles.
* Establish appropriate measures to assess the impact of journey changes on customer experience, service quality, turnaround time and operational performance.

**Process Optimisation and Continuous Improvement**

* Apply appropriate process-improvement methodologies to assess and redesign end-to-end processes.
* Develop current-state and future-state process maps, service blueprints and supporting design documentation.
* Identify opportunities to remove process debt, reduce manual activity, simplify hand-offs and improve first-time-right outcomes.
* Use operational data, customer insight and colleague feedback to identify root causes and prioritise improvement opportunities.
* Assess opportunities to improve productivity, create capacity and strengthen process resilience.
* Embed continuous-improvement principles within future-state processes and operating models.
* Support the identification, validation, measurement and tracking of transformation benefits.

**Digital, Automation and AI Enablement**

* Identify and assess opportunities to use digital workflow, automation, process mining, analytics, artificial intelligence and generative AI within Business Banking journeys.
* Work with Product and Technology partners to translate business requirements into appropriate digital and technology capabilities.
* Support the assessment of technology feasibility, business value, operational impact and control implications.
* Ensure that proposed technology solutions are integrated into the wider operating model rather than implemented as isolated process changes.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of workflow, case-management and AI-enabled servicing solutions.
* Promote responsible adoption of technology, with appropriate consideration of governance, data, customer outcomes, operational resilience and controls.

**Transformation Planning and Delivery**

* Translate agreed target-state designs into structured and executable delivery roadmaps.
* Define delivery phases, dependencies, business readiness requirements, risks, assumptions and intended outcomes.
* Support the development of business cases, investment proposals and governance submissions.
* Partner with change and delivery teams to transition designs from concept through mobilisation, implementation and embedding.
* Provide design oversight during delivery to ensure that implemented changes remain aligned with agreed target-state principles.
* Identify and manage design risks, dependencies and issues, escalating where appropriate.
* Support pilot, test-and-learn and phased implementation approaches where these are appropriate.
* Monitor delivery progress, benefit realisation and adoption against agreed measures.
* Produce clear updates, recommendations and decision papers for senior stakeholders and governance forums.

**Risk and Control**

* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work performed.
* Ensure target operating models and journey designs appropriately consider regulatory requirements, operational risk, customer outcomes, data, privacy and control effectiveness.
* Identify potential risks and control impacts arising from process, technology, organisational or operating-model changes.
* Engage Risk, Compliance, Legal and Control stakeholders at the appropriate stages of design and delivery.
* Ensure key controls, accountabilities, governance arrangements and escalation routes are clearly reflected in the future-state design.
* Support completion of relevant risk assessments, governance reviews and approvals.
* Escalate material design, delivery or control concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
* Ensure all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements, the Enterprise Risk Management Framework and applicable internal Barclays policies and standards.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include**

* Experience identifying and evaluating opportunities across digital workflow, automation, process mining, analytics, artificial intelligence and generative AI, including consideration of business value, operational impact, governance and controls.
* Experience developing business cases, benefits assessments, executive papers and senior-management updates, and providing design oversight through mobilisation, implementation and embedding.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in our Gurugram/Noida.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To collaborate with stakeholders and use data and MI to identify process optimisation opportunities for capacity creation in relevant business areas.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of strategies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of banking operations, using data led insights.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve performance & optimisation efficiency and effectiveness.
* Development of reports and presentations on performance & optimisation and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments, and collaboration with stakeholders across the bank to provide recommendations for change and improvement within performance and optimisation processes.
* Development and implementation of analytics and reporting performance & optimisation to mitigate risks and maintain efficient operations.
* Identification of capacity creation in operations using data and Management Information.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.

We are looking for a hands-on UI Lead to drive frontend engineering across UniCommerce’s product ecosystem. The role involves leading the development of scalable, high-performance, and maintainable user interfaces for complex e-commerce and SaaS products.

**The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Angular/React, strong frontend architecture capabilities, and proven experience leading engineers. \* Partner with Product Managers, Backend Engineers, QA, and UX teams to deliver end-to-end product features.

\* Translate business requirements into technical solutions and implementation plans.

\* Work with REST APIs and backend services to deliver seamless product integrations.

\* Contribute to sprint planning, effort estimation, technical documentation, and release readiness.

**5. Engineering Excellence**

\* Establish unit testing, integration testing, and frontend quality standards using tools such as Jasmine, Karma, or Jest, as appropriate.

\* Improve build pipelines, CI/CD processes, and frontend release practices.

\* Evaluate new tools, frameworks, and engineering approaches that improve developer productivity.

\* Drive technical debt reduction and ensure long-term sustainability of the frontend codebase.

**Required Skills & Experience**

\* 7–12 years of experience in frontend development, with substantial hands-on experience in Angular.

\* Strong proficiency in Angular/React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive UI development.

\* Experience with state management, API integration, frontend performance optimisation, and browser debugging.

\* Familiarity with Git, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and modern frontend build tools.

\* Proven experience mentoring engineers, reviewing code, and leading technical delivery.

\* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to balance architectural quality with product delivery timelines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

\* Experience working on SaaS, e-commerce, order management, inventory management, warehouse management, or supply-chain technology products.

\* Exposure to micro-frontend architecture and shared component libraries.

\* Experience with design systems, accessibility standards, and frontend security.

\* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and cross-functional product engineering.

**Success Measures**

\* Scalable and maintainable Angular architecture across product modules.

\* Improved frontend performance, reliability, and code quality.

\* Predictable delivery of product features with reduced production defects.

\* Effective mentoring and improved productivity of the frontend engineering team.

\* Reduced technical debt and increased reuse of frontend components.

A hands-on Angular/React expert who combines strong frontend architecture with people leadership, takes ownership of engineering quality, and can scale complex enterprise product interfaces without compromising performance or maintainability.

description:
Every company knows how to generate pipelines. Very few know how to deliver consistently at scale.

At SalesMonk, we're building AI-native GTM systems that help customers turn events and outbound into predictable revenue. As we grow, the biggest challenge isn't shipping more work- it's building the operating system that ensures every customer engagement is executed consistently, efficiently, and repeatedly.

That's where this role comes in.

Today, our delivery works because smart people are solving problems every day.

Tomorrow, it needs to work because we've built systems that make great execution repeatable.

We're looking for someone who can build the processes, operating rhythms, and delivery playbooks that allow us to scale without adding operational chaos.

This isn't a project management role, this is a systems-building role.

You'll work directly with the founders to create the delivery engine that supports the next stage of the company.

**What You Will Own**

**Build the Delivery Operating System**

Design how delivery should work- from customer kickoff to successful execution.

Build repeatable workflows, SOPs, templates, governance, and playbooks that reduce dependency on tribal knowledge.

**Drive Delivery Excellence**

Identify bottlenecks, eliminate operational friction, and continuously improve execution quality.

Ensure delivery standards remain high as the team scales.

**Cross-functional Execution**

Work closely with Product, GTM Engineers, Customer Success, and the founders to ensure priorities move quickly.

Bring structure, accountability, and visibility across teams.

**Process & Automation**

Identify manual workflows that should be standardized or automated.

Help build scalable systems that improve speed, quality, and consistency.

**Metrics & Continuous Improvement**

Define what great delivery looks like.

Build dashboards and operating metrics around delivery quality, turnaround time, customer outcomes, and execution efficiency.

Use data to continuously improve the way we operate.

description:
**Who we are:**

Roundglass is a wholistic wellbeing company working to empower healthier lives, stronger communities, and a more sustainable world. That w in wholistic is intentional: We believe true wellbeing spans the whole human experience, from how we care for ourselves to our connections with others and the planet.

This philosophy shapes both what we build and how we work. We’ve created an environment where supporting people’s whole selves fuels their most meaningful work.

Roundglass creates real-world impact through two core pillars:

Roundglass Giving is our nonprofit arm that drives philanthropic work in youth development, women's equity, and environmental sustainability. Our mission is to transform communities by tackling systemic challenges and unlocking human potential through Roundglass Sports, Roundglass Sustain, the Roundglass Foundation, and the Global India Institute (GIC). These efforts have reached millions of people, creating scalable models of community-led change.

Through the Roundglass Living platform, we deliver personalized wellbeing guidance rooted in science. The Roundglass Living app helps people develop habits that last through breathwork, meditation, movement, nutrition, music, and more.

We built Roundglass on the belief that people thrive when they’re supported wholistically, and we apply this philosophy to how we work together as a team. If you're passionate about transforming communities and creating systemic change and want to contribute to a culture that embodies the impact we're creating, we'd love to meet you.

**About the Role**

Roundglass Creative Studio is looking for a detail-oriented Associate with a strong interest in non-fiction storytelling, a grounding in documentary research and production processes, and the ability to work confidently in fast-paced, real-world environments.

The ideal candidate will work closely with the Creative Lead and support the development and production of films across the Studio. The role involves coordinating with internal teams, programme teams, community members, contributors, and external production crews through every stage of the filmmaking process — from story discovery, research and validation to pre-production, field shoots, post-production, and final delivery.

We are looking for someone who understands that a strong documentary film begins long before the camera starts rolling. It requires curiosity, thorough research, careful validation, an understanding of context, and detailed preparation. It means finding the layers within a story - understanding not only what happened, but why it matters, whose perspective needs to be represented, and what will make the story meaningful to an audience.

The role requires someone who is comfortable going across Punjab, comfortable meeting people and communities, listening closely, and asking the right questions. The candidate should be able to observe and identify the impact of different programmes and help translate that into strong, research-backed pre-production material.

The Associate will help ensure that research, contributors, production requirements, references, footage, feedback, and post-production workflows are organized and followed through carefully.

**What you’ll do:**

**End-to-End Project Coordination | Development to Post-Production**

* Conduct in-depth online and field research to support story discovery, development, and validation.
* Support the Creative Lead in identifying strong case studies and contributors and ensuring that research and narrative choices remain aligned with the film’s creative objective.
* Develop and organise research notes, contributor profiles, beat sheets, step outlines, visual references, and shot breakdowns in line with the creative direction.
* Coordinate with writers on scripts, revisions, feedback, and timely submissions.
* Support pre-production planning and crew coordination, ensuring clarity and alignment on schedules, requirements, deliverables, and expectations across departments.
* Coordinate closely with internal programme teams, contributors, communities, and external production partners to ensure information and production requirements are communicated accurately and on time.
* Across all productions, ensure adherence to Roundglass standards, design guidelines, science and factual accuracy, safety protocols, compliances, and ethical storytelling practices.

**On-Ground Shoot Coordination**

* Act as a key bridge between the creative team, production crew, programme teams, and contributors during shoots.
* Help ensure contributors, locations, scenes, and production requirements are ready and coordinated according to the shooting plan.
* Track shot sequences and coverage requirements, helping the team stay aligned with the creative brief while responding to the realities of the field.
* Maintain detailed shoot logs, contributor notes, coverage records, and production documentation to ensure continuity from production into post-production.
* Manage on-ground flow and troubleshoot coordination challenges as they arise, supporting the crew in making informed decisions within real-time constraints.

**Post-Production Support**

* Work closely with the post-production team to ensure that creative briefs, footage, research, contributor context, and production notes are clearly organised and handed over.
* Provide editorial support through shoot logs, story notes, contributor and character context, transcripts, research material, and visual references.
* Coordinate across different stages of post-production, including editing, graphics, sound, colour, reviews, feedback, and final delivery, as required.
* Track post-production schedules, review rounds, feedback, approval gateways, and deliverables to ensure projects move efficiently through each stage.
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration between creative, programme, and external teams, ensuring feedback is consolidated, communicated clearly, and followed through.
* Maintain organised project documentation and ensure that final masters, project files, assets, and supporting material are properly managed, handed over and archived.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Minimum 5 years’ experience in documentary or non-fiction filmmaking as Researcher, Assistant Director or in a related role.
* Strong understanding of visual storytelling and narrative structures.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills– ability to navigate ground realities and communicate across departments and communities.
* Fluency in English (spoken and written).Conversational Hindi and Punjabi.
* Willingness to travel and work on location in rural and semi-urban areas of Punjab.
* Prior experience in filmmaking, being on the set, scheduling, field research and production management is a must.

**What You'll Do**

* Build across functions: Develop a broad understanding of strategy, GTM, operations, and commercial decision-making.

title: Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:

Last date to apply : 28th Oct
  
  
We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.

description:
**Senior Client Engineer (Gurugram-Hybrid)**
**About Finova**
Finova is the UK's leading lending and savings technology provider, supporting one in every five mortgages nationwide. Our agile, cloud-native solutions enable over 60 banks, building societies, specialist lenders, equity release providers and a network of 2,400+ brokers to stay ahead in a competitive market.
  
  
Built on open architecture and backed by deep industry expertise, our platform is designed to scale. Each year, we process over £50 billion in loans, manage nearly £50 billion in savings, and support the digital servicing of more than 650,000 UK borrower accounts.
  
  
Be part of a team that’s driving innovation, enabling growth and shaping the future of UK lending.
  
  
**For Lenders**
Finova offers a flexible, modular technology suite designed to help lenders move faster, scale efficiently and deliver standout digital experiences.
  
  
Financial Institutions use Finova to launch products faster, process applications up to 50% more efficiently and reduce operational costs — all while staying fully compliant in a fast-moving market.
  
  
**About the Role:**
As a Senior Engineer at Finova, you will play a key role in developing, enhancing, and maintaining our core UK lending and digital banking platforms. You will design and write clean, scalable code using C#, .NET MVC, JavaScript, SQL, and RESTful APIs, ensuring high performance, security, and reliability across our software solutions. Working in an Agile environment, you will participate in code reviews, resolve complex technical issues, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful software features.

* Leading technical delivery on user stories: estimating effort, build complex configurations and integrations.
* Participate in refinement sessions to ensure stories meet acceptance criteria and are sprint ready.

* Liaising with clients or third-party engineers on complex technical issues (interfaces, integrations).

* Providing release support and contributing to production-issue diagnosis and resolution.

**What will you be doing?**
In terms of your experience, your attitude is everything, but we'd particularly love to see your:
  
  

* Experienced or proficiency in C#, .NET MVC, JavaScript, SQL and RESTful APIs. Confidence in code reviews, ensuring quality and adherence to best practice.
* Ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to stakeholders and escalate issues appropriately.
* Experience of Agile delivery at scale, from planning through to warranty support.
* Demonstrable track record of guiding junior team members through coaching or formal training.
* Commitment to continuous learning, sharing insights via presentations or internal communities.

**What we Offer:**

* Hybrid working: We operate on a flexible hybrid model that gives you the choice and freedom to balance working from the office and working remotely.
* Private medical insurance: Comprehensive health floater cover covering your spouse and children, ensuring complete medical protection for your family.

* Flexible Holiday Package: Enjoy 30 days paid holiday (plus 10 public holidays) with the option to encash or carry forward unused leaves into the next year.

We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re passionate about this role but don’t meet all the criteria, please reach out, we’d love to discuss how your skills and experiences align with our needs.

description:
**Role Title :**
AVP , Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect ( L11 )
  
  
**Company Overview:**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Quality Engineering Center of Excellence (QE COE) is a centralized team of Quality Engineering Leaders and Test Architects, that standardizes, scales, and governs software quality, test automation, and best practices across the organization. This team works closely with the Leaders in the Engineering verticals and other cross functional teams who are the key stakeholders. This role will work closely with other peer Test Architects in the team under the leadership of the QE Leader to rollout and institutionalize the AI driven QE strategies and solutions conceptualized by the team, in partnership with the Application Teams.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect**
Drive the design and delivery of next-generation Quality Engineering solutions by blending proven testing methodologies with AI-powered approaches. This role will occasionally architect scalable testing frameworks, champion adoption of AI-assisted testing, and embed intelligent automation across the product development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate high-quality delivery.
  
  
As an SME in AI-enabled test automation engineering, this role will partner with peer architects and stakeholders to define strategy, recommend the optimal tool stack aligned to the application landscape, and resolve complex automation challenges—delivering best-in-class, enterprise-wide automation expansion solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and own scalable test automation frameworks for functional, regression, and non-functional testing; embed automation into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub, CloudBees) as required by the Application teams.
* Define and drive QE standards, best practices, and reusable libraries/patterns across engineering teams.

* Mentorship & Influence: Proven track record of guiding junior engineers, driving engineering consensus across disparate teams, and leading technical initiatives without direct authority.

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

**Your Impact**
You will contribute to building analytical products that help clients improve healthcare outcomes, leveraging modern data engineering tools and practices.
  
  
Working as part of a team on active client engagements, you will support initiatives focused on delivering more affordable, accessible, and high-quality healthcare globally.
  
  
You will join our Client Capabilities Network in Gurugram or Bengaluru as part of the HALO (Healthcare Access, Quality, and Outcomes) domain within the SHaPE (Social, Healthcare and Public Entities) practice.
  
  
You will design and develop interactive dashboards and visualizations using tools such as Power BI, enabling clear and effective communication of insights to clients and internal stakeholders. You will also leverage emerging Generative AI tools and agent-based workflows to support delivery tasks such as code generation, data transformation, and documentation, improving productivity and solution quality.
  
  
In collaboration with data engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders, you will support the development and maintenance of data pipelines, software applications, and scalable data frameworks, including reusable assets that enable efficient data processing and analysis across projects. Your work also involves configuring and delivering data and software solutions aligned with client needs, while supporting client interactions where required.
  
  
You will translate client requirements into data models, configurations, and implementation steps under supervision, ensuring alignment with product capabilities. Applying structured problem-solving, you will help troubleshoot data and implementation challenges, while ensuring data quality and consistency in visualizations through validation of data sources and adherence to best practices in dashboard design. You will also contribute to documentation, knowledge sharing, and capability building across data engineering, visualization, and software tools.
  
  
SHaPE fosters innovation driven by advanced analytics, user experience design thinking, predictive forecasting to develop new products/services and integrating them into our client work. It is helping to shift our model towards asset-based consulting and is a foundation for our entrepreneurial culture.
  
  
**Your Qualifications and Skills**- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

title: Product Engineer (App and Platforms)
description:

This is a delivery-focused role rather than a purely supervisory one: you will carry out the majority of the day-to-day design, development, and implementation work directly. You will be Ansh's primary technical owner of our app and website, working closely with our Analytics Engineer to ensure data flows cleanly from the app into our dashboards, with the M& E and program teams to understand their requirements, and with the C-suite to ensure our technology and roadmap keep pace with our growth. Our tech team is small, so this role calls for a startup mentality and the initiative to step outside a predefined job description when something needs doing, rather than waiting to be asked. The candidate will have responsibilities across the following functions: Develop and improve our field app: - Design and implement new features within our FlutterFlow app, from requirements gathering through to build and delivery, translating input from the M& E and operations teams into working functionality. - Maintain the app's underlying databases, including making manual data updates where required. - Own the full bug and issue-tracking cycle, identifying, prioritising, assigning, and resolving issues that affect app stability, data collection, or care delivery. - Manage version control and releases, testing and publishing new app versions, writing release notes, and notifying the team of changes. - Manage app accounts and access for team members, providing technical support where needed. - Periodically review and improve the app's design, evaluating user interface and user experience to improve usability. Maintain our website, tech systems and accounts: - Maintain and update Ansh's website (built in Wix), including content changes, functionality fixes, and periodic design/UX review. - Manage and maintain integrations with third-party tools (e. g., Trello, Slack, Google Workspace tools, Firebase), keeping systems efficient, up-to-date, and aligned with organisational needs. - Manage accounts and access for the tools and platforms our team relies on day-to-day (e. g. app accounts, website admin access, and other core tools), including onboarding and offboarding team members from a technical standpoint. - Conduct orientation on technology and tools for new team members. - Maintain basic security hygiene across the systems you own: access permissions, password practices, and account recovery. - Ensure backups for FlutterFlow, GitHub, and Firestore are conducted and monitored. - Support with ad-hoc technology projects and transitions, e. g. changing our Google Workspace. - Support with increased AI integration and technology innovation across the organisation. Follow good technical practice: - Apply sound engineering practices to keep our dashboards and app reliable and maintainable as they scale, rather than optimising only for short-term delivery. - Document your work clearly, so that systems and decisions are understood across the organisation rather than held only by you. - Recommend new tools or approaches that would help Ansh's team deliver more effectively. Work closely with the C-suite and program team: - Support the C-suite in building the product roadmap for our app and website, bringing a technical perspective on feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. - Bring a technical perspective into strategic planning conversations, so Ansh's data and tooling keep pace with its growth ambitions. - Partner with M& E and program leads to prioritise what gets built next, based on what will most improve data quality, decision-making, or field operations. Requirements: - Around 3+ years of relevant experience, including hands-on work developing mobile or low-code app platforms (FlutterFlow, Flutter, or comparable front-end platforms). - Comfortable using AI-assisted coding tools (e. g. Claude Code) as part of a modern development workflow, with the discipline to keep the resulting code maintainable rather than simply expedient. - Comfortable managing accounts, access, and basic security practices across a small set of tools and platforms. - Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements from non-technical colleagues into technical specifications, and to explain technical trade-offs back to them clearly. - High ownership and agency: comfortable being the primary technical owner of these systems in a rapidly growing organisation, and able to resolve blockers independently. - Adaptability: comfortable supporting new technology projects as they arise. - Fluent in English; based in India and comfortable working remotely with a distributed, mission-driven team. - Deep alignment with Ansh's mission, and a serious, evidence-based commitment to impact. Strongly preferred/nice to have: - Direct experience with FlutterFlow specifically. - Experience with website builders such as Wix, Webflow, or similar. - Experience integrating data from custom-built mobile or field applications into analytics tools. - Experience contributing to product prioritisation or roadmap discussions. - Familiarity with data privacy and security considerations for health data. - Fluency in Hindi. Company Summary Globally, 2.4 million children died in the first month of life in 2020 India alone accounted for 22% of these newborn deaths. The leading risk factor for mortality among children under five years of age is low birth weight, which is responsible for more than 80% of neonatal deaths. A simple solution holds the potential to significantly reduce these deaths: placing low birth weight infants directly onto the mother's chest for skin-to-skin contact, an intervention known as Kangaroo Care (KC). KC entails not only prolonged and continuous skin-to-skin contact but also exclusive breastfeeding and close monitoring of the infant. KC has proven to effectively reduce mortality and morbidity rates by around 33% (compared to the standard of care using electric incubators) by preventing hypothermia, fighting infections like sepsis, and helping the newborn gain weight through the caregiver's heat. However, adoption barriers for kangaroo care in LMICs, such as India, persist. These include insufficient equipment, a shortage of human resources, and a lack of privacy within healthcare facilities. Many of our target healthcare facilities even lack the infrastructure for conventional standard of care (i. e., electric incubators), further amplifying the potential impact of Kangaroo Care in low-resource settings. Our approach is both direct and cost-effective: repurpose existing hospital spaces to facilitate KC, provide essential equipment like infant weighing scales and cloth binders, and expand capacity by training and hiring health workers (HW) dedicated to teaching and monitoring KC for mothers in the wards. Why Join Us Ansh is committed to equal opportunity. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and strongly encourage applications from people who are underrepresented in this sector. We do not discriminate based on gender, age, disability, caste, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race. We are looking for someone genuinely interested in people and equally comfortable with the process. You will need to hold confidence, tell leadership things they may not want to hear, and keep the administrative backbone of the function running!

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**What is Hunch?**
Hunch is a dating app built for follow-through - designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back-and-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.
  
  
With 2.4M+ daters, 1.47M+ dates planned, and 100% photo-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post-AI world.
  
  
Link to our fundraising announcement
  
  
**Key Offerings Of Hunch**

* One Drop a Day: A small, hand-picked set of photo-verified profiles arrives daily - chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.
* Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place - no logistics to manage.
* Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing - just real, trustworthy connections.
* Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time - nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.

**About The Role**
We're on the lookout for a SDE-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We’re looking for immediate joiners. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own backend features end-to-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket.
* Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy).
* Own async & event-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.)
* Ship LLM-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users.
* Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.
* Dual-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node + Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice-to-have" role.
* Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.
* Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.
* Service design & delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.
* End-to-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product-engineer experience is a huge plus.
* Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.

**Preferred Experience**

* ML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.
* LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus.
* Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
* Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly.
* Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive pay along with an annual performance-linked incentive (PLI).
* Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.
* Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).

**Life at Hunch**
Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall - getting two interested people into the same room.
  
  
**What We Hire For - The ABCs**
Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:
  
  

* Authenticity - Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.
* Boldness - Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.
* Curiosity - The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.

**How We Work**

* Ownership, not theater - You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.
* Flexibility that's real - We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week - show up for the stuff that matters.
* Move fast, don't burn out - Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.
* Small team, big problems - You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.

**Backed by Global Investors**
Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.
  
  
**Experienced Leadership**
Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) - serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer-tech startup.

Tejaki — by Blowtrumpet Technologies

**ABOUT Tejaki**
Tejaki is Blowtrumpet’s publisher-facing supply-side platform (SSP), built for content creators who want transparent monetisation. Tejaki runs on offers — not blind bids — so creators know what they are earning and why. It supports multiple content formats and fair revenue distribution. Tejaki is a product under Blowtrumpet Technologies.
  
  
THE ROLE
  
  
Build creator-first experiences — onboarding flows, earnings transparency, content upload pipelines, and monetisation controls that feel fair and empowering to publishers of every size.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead UX research — user interviews, usability testing, task analysis, and journey mapping
* Design user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes
* Build and iterate on front-end implementations based on usability data
* Define information architecture and navigation patterns across product surfaces
* Set up analytics and event tracking to measure user behaviour and task completion
* Advocate for the user in architecture and product decisions

**What We Are Looking For**

* Background in HCI, interaction design, or UX engineering
* Proficiency in React/Next.js — you prototype in code, not just in Figma
* Experience running usability studies and translating findings into design changes
* Understanding of accessibility, cognitive load, and information hierarchy
* Strong analytical skills — comfortable with analytics tools and A/B testing
* Portfolio showing UX-driven engineering work, not just visual design

EARLY CAREER & CAMPUS TALENT
  
  
We are actively inviting
**early-career graduates**
and
**final-year interns**
to consider long-term opportunities in innovation and establish stable careers with us in one of the most promising industry segments. If you are looking to create a ding in the universe, this may be your chance.
  
  
Blowtrumpet is not just offering a job — we are offering a seat at the table where the future of advertising technology is being designed. You will work with small, focused teams, learn from practitioners, ship real products, and grow into a career that compounds.
  
  
STATEMENT OF PURPOSE
  
  
Along with your application, please include a
**Statement of Purpose**
that covers:
  
  

* What interests you in advertising and technology — what drew you to this space?
* When you started programming, designing, exploring this opportunity, or engaging with the field — and what you have built or learned so far.
* Your 3–5 year career vision — where do you see yourself, what kind of work excites you, and what impact do you want to make?
* How Blowtrumpet or this project fits into that picture — why us, why now, and what you hope to bring.

WORKING AT BLOWTRUMPET
  
  
We function like a startup — and we are proud of it. That means you will wear multiple hats, take ownership beyond your title, and grow faster than you would in a larger organisation. We are looking for people who thrive on that kind of pace.
  
  
**A Few Things To Know Upfront**

* Multi-functional by design. Everyone here contributes across boundaries. If you see a gap, you fill it. If you can learn it, you own it.
* Excellence is non-negotiable. We have no room for mediocrity. We would rather ship fewer things brilliantly than many things passably.
* Growth-oriented. We invest in training, mentorship, and giving you real responsibility early. Your growth is the company’s growth.
* Early starts, disciplined days. We are based in South Delhi and our working day begins at 8 AM. We believe discipline creates freedom — starting early lets us work with focus, finish with intention, and keep stress low.
* Low stress, high standards. We keep the environment calm and supportive. People here help each other, cover for each other, and win together. The pressure comes from the pursuit of great work, not from mismanagement.

**How To Apply**
Join our Discord server to start the conversation:
  
  
https://discord.com/invite/6qZe3tvnWB
  
  
You are also welcome to join HFW
  
  

* Designers on WhatsApp — part of Hire For Work (HFW), an open community initiative of Blowtrumpet where you can interact with HR professionals, hiring managers, and fellow candidates. https://chat.whatsapp.com/LHrExaH5Z5yCmSO2FjtJbh

Also check out HFW

**Blowtrumpet Technologies**
, regardless of which product you join.

title: Product Engineer - Software Reliability
description:
**Overview**
Esri is the world leader in geographic information systems (GIS) and developer of ArcGIS, the leading mapping and analytics software used in 75 percent of Fortune 500 companies. At Esri, we believe in helping our customers take on challenging geospatial problems and making a difference in the world. Join our team of talented and passionate engineers and help us build the next generation of ArcGIS Enterprise, a suite of products delivering state-of-the-art geospatial capability to thousands of our customers and millions of users worldwide. Our team builds cutting-edge, highly scalable, and reliable distributed software for on-premises and the cloud. We make maps, geographic information, and analyses available on any device, anywhere, at any time.
  
  
Software Reliability Engineers are responsible for ensuring that the ArcGIS Enterprise product is reliable, highly available, and has powerful disaster recovery features. They do this by gathering user requirements, defining them for the team, evaluating the product, and guiding users through documentation, videos, and presentations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support Esri's strong user-focus by gathering software reliability and availability requirements
* Collect requirements directly from users and indirectly from Esri staff in Support and Professional Services
* Collaborate and influence decisions within and across teams because reliability features and requirements cut across all functionalities
* Prioritize and guarantee software quality by creating test plans, automating those tests, evaluating the results, and ensuring that defects are acted upon
* Communicate effectively with our users through written documentation as well as presentations

**Requirements**

* 2-6 years in a position with operational responsibilities, such as monitoring, maintaining, and deploying enterprise software
* Experience in software testing
* Fundamental understanding of web services, such as REST
* Demonstrated problem-solving skills in a complex backend-server stack
* Effective communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science and applications, math, GIS, geography, or related field
* Existing work authorization for India

**Recommended Qualifications**

* Master's degree in engineering, computer science and applications, math, GIS, geography, or related field
* Experience administering ArcGIS Enterprise
* Experience working directly on a software development team

**The Company**
At Esri, diversity is more than just a word on a map. When employees of different experiences, perspectives, backgrounds, and cultures come together, we are more innovative and ultimately a better place to work. We believe in having a diverse workforce that is unified under our mission of creating positive global change. We understand that diversity, equity, and inclusion is not a destination but an ongoing process. We are committed to the continuation of learning, growing, and changing our workplace so every employee can contribute to their life’s best work. Our commitment to these principles extends to the global communities we serve by creating positive change with GIS technology. For more information on Esri’s Racial Equity and Social Justice initiatives, please visit our website here.
  
  
**If you don’t meet all of the preferred qualifications for this position, we encourage you to still apply!**
Esri is an equal opportunity employer (EOE) and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email askcareers@esri.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this e-mail address.
  
  
Esri Privacy Esri takes our responsibility to protect your privacy seriously. We are committed to respecting your privacy by providing transparency in how we acquire and use your information, giving you control of your information and preferences, and holding ourselves to the highest national and international standards, including CCPA and GDPR compliance.

title: Product Associate - Apprentice
description:
**Department:**
Product Management
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Apprentice
  
  
**Location:**
India
  
  
**Description**
**About the Program**
The Eptura Apprenticeship Program is designed to provide recent graduates and early-career professionals with meaningful, hands-on experience within a global SaaS organization. Throughout this 12-month program, apprentices will receive mentoring, structured learning opportunities, and exposure to commercial operations and sales processes.
  
  
**Eligibility**
**To Be Considered For This Apprenticeship, Candidates Must**

* Have completed a Bachelor's degree within the past two years, OR
* Be in the final year of their degree program and eligible for apprenticeship participation
* Have no more than two years of professional work experience
* Be legally eligible to participate in an apprenticeship program in India

**Shape the Future of Work with Eptura**
At Eptura, we're not just another tech company—we're a global leader transforming the way people, workplaces, and assets connect. Our innovative worktech solutions empower 25 million users across 115 countries to thrive in a digitally connected world. Trusted by 45% of Fortune 500 companies, we're redefining workplace innovation and driving success for organizations around the globe.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Product Associate, you will work directly within our Gurugram engineering team, helping to shepherd product enhancements and customer-reported issues through Eptura's AI Development Lifecycle (AIDLC). You'll connect product priorities and engineering execution, keeping work organized, clearly specified, and moving forward on our Jira kanban boards.
  
  
This is a role for someone who is curious, organized, and eager to learn how great software products are built. You don't need prior experience in product management. You do need strong attention to detail, clear communication, demonstrated capabilities in using AI, and a genuine interest in how technology solves real-world problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage and maintain the Jira kanban board: keeping tickets well-organized, clearly described, and appropriately prioritized in collaboration with engineering leads.
* Help triage incoming product enhancement requests and customer-reported defects, gathering the context engineers need to act on them.
* Work with AI to write clear, structured user stories and acceptance criteria that translate business needs into actionable engineering tasks.
* Coordinate with engineers to track progress, surface blockers, and ensure items move efficiently through the AIDLC stages.
* Participate in requirement-gathering conversations with product managers and stakeholders, capturing key decisions and open questions.
* Assist in drafting functional specifications and supporting documentation for new or enhanced product features, also working with AI.
* Support basic testing activities: reviewing completed work against acceptance criteria and flagging discrepancies.
* Contribute to ongoing improvement of our AIDLC processes and team ways of working.

**About You**
We're looking for a motivated self-starter who is keen to build a career in product or technology. The following will set you up for success in this role:
  
  

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English: you'll be writing tickets, specs, and summaries that engineers and stakeholders rely on.
* High attention to detail and a methodical approach to organizing information.
* Comfort working in a structured, process-driven environment: you like things to be clear, tracked, and accounted for.
* Curiosity about how software products are built and a willingness to ask questions.
* Familiarity with project or task management tools (Jira experience is a plus).
* A proactive mindset: you spot gaps, follow up, and take ownership of your work.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess AI outputs, identify limitations or risks, and recommend improvements to enhance product value.
* AI-related experience:
* Understanding of AI fundamentals, including large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, automation workflows, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience using AI tools to improve productivity: research, data analysis, content creation, or workflow automation, either through academic, personal, or professional projects. Ability to build and demonstrate an AI agent.
* Ability to evaluate Ai-driven product opportunities, gathering feedback and translating it into feature recommendations.

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to agile or kanban workflows (even in an academic or personal project context).
* Basic understanding of software development concepts: you don't need to code, but knowing what engineers do helps.
* Prior internship, project, or coursework related to business analysis, product management, or software delivery.

**Benefits**

* Monthly stipend
* Health Insurance fully paid – Self
* 13 Public Holidays
* Hyrid working policy
* Exposure to the latest trends and technologies in the SaaS industry.
* Mentorship from global experienced professionals in the sales, renewals and customer success fields.
* Potential for career advancement based on performance and dedication.

**Eptura Information**

* Follow us on Twitter | LinkedIn | Facebook | YouTube
* At Eptura, we believe strong teams are built through collaboration, flexibility, and a range of perspectives grounded in skill and experience. We strive to create an environment where people can do their best work, contribute meaningfully, and grow alongside our business.

title: Senior QE Engineer
description:
For over four decades, PAR Technology Corporation (NYSE: PAR) has been a leader in restaurant technology, empowering brands worldwide to create lasting connections with their guests. Our innovative solutions and commitment to excellence provide comprehensive software and hardware that enable seamless experiences and drive growth for over 100,000 restaurants in more than 110 countries. Embracing our "Better Together" ethos, we offer Unified Customer Experience solutions, combining point-of-sale, digital ordering, loyalty and back-office software solutions as well as industry-leading hardware and drive-thru offerings. To learn more, visit partech.com or connect with us on LinkedIn, X (formerly Twitter), Facebook, and Instagram.
  
  
**Position Description**
Senior QE Engineer
  
  
We’re looking for a
**Senior QE Engineer**
with deep expertise in automation and performance testing to help us deliver high-quality software at scale. In this role, you’ll serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on quality practices, design robust test strategies, and contribute to building scalable and reliable systems. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams in a CI/CD environment to drive automation, performance testing, and quality initiatives across the platform.
  
  
**Position Location**
Jaipur/Gurugram
  
  
**Reports To**
Manager QE
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**

* Own performance testing using JMeter or similar tools, identifying system bottlenecks and collaborating with engineering teams to optimize.
* Develop and maintain robust, scalable automation frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, Rest Assured).
* Contribute to test strategy, planning, execution, and reporting.
* Ensure E2E test coverage across UI, API and backend systems.
* Work closely with development teams to identify root causes and provide performance tuning suggestions.
* Identifies opportunities to adopt innovative testing technologies and techniques.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging testing tools and frameworks to improve test efficiency.

**With a Side Of (additional Skills)**

* Exposure to Big Data or AI/ML products.
* Understanding of security testing concepts (OWASP, DAST, SAST) is a plus.

**Unleash your potential: What you will be doing and owning:**

* 8+ years in quality engineering with strong focus on automation and performance testing.
* Strong knowledge of performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling).
* Experience with monitoring and profiling tools for performance monitoring.
* Strong in Java/Python/JavaScript based automation frameworks.
* Hands-on experience in CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
* Solid experience in test, functional testing, system integration testing, regression testing, GUI testing, API/web service testing, and browser compatibility testing
* Familiarity with test management tools like Zephyr
* Deep understanding of software quality best practices, shift-left testing, and test pyramid principles.

**Interview Process**
Interview #1: Phone Screen with Talent Acquisition Team
  
  
Interview #2: Video interview with the Technical Teams (via MS Teams/F2F)
  
  
Interview #3: Video interview with the Hiring Manager (via MS Teams/F2F)

We also provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, or for your role at PAR, please contact accommodations@partech.com. If you’d like more information about your EEO rights as an applicant, please visit the US Department of Labor's website.

title: Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.
