title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.
  
  
Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.
  
  
**a Purpose Driven Company – 150 Years**
While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.
  
  
At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.
  
  
Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As a Lead, Business Systems Analyst on the Financial Risk Technology (Summit/Calypso) team, you will report to the Lead, Software Engineer (Financial Risk Technology) and partner with product owners, tech leads, designers, engineers and delivery professionals to drive quality assurance (QA) testing. You will act as the primary interface between Technology and specific business areas, identifying business requirements, creating project and process specifications, and coordinating with project teams. You will ensure projects stay on schedule and within budget while helping solve complex business problems and deliver innovative products, services, and experiences to delight our customers!
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Support the Lead, Software Engineer setting ambitious and clear product vision, and communicating ‘the story’ effectively to key stakeholders and the rest of the team; begin to identify opportunities to provide input to the team and coach others with occasional guidance
* Collaborate with product owners in understanding needs and defining feature stories, tech leads in defining technical design and other team members to understand the system end-to-end and deliver robust solutions that bring about business impact
* Work on extremely complex problems in which analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of often complex variables related to technology and/or data; exercise independent judgment in developing methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.
* Own the end-to-end product strategy from inception and determine business value once solution enters production
* Ensure alignment of product features and stories (i.e., review, give feedback, and prioritize user stories in line with product vision)
* Understand the vision and own aspects of product management / roadmap activities
* Use programming languages including but not limited to SQL, Oracle SQL, Test Management Tools, Agile, SDLC, Git and GitHub, Jira (Basics), and Microsoft Tools

**The Skills And Expertise You Will Bring**

* Bachelor of Computer Science or Engineering; Analytics or experience in related fields
* 5-7 years of experience in Calypso Application testing in critical modules including Collateral, Pricing Difference, UFT, VBScript, and API testing (SOAP & REST); experience in Functional and Regression testing with hands-on experience in the QFrame automation framework
* Experience with agile development methodologies and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
* Knowledge of business concepts, tools and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business
* Ability to learn new skills and knowledge on an on-going basis through self-initiative and tackling challenges
* Excellent problem solving, communication and collaboration skills
* Applied experience and/or expertise with several of the following:
* Project/Product Management: Planning, Progress Monitoring and Status Reporting, including visualization of works; Scaling Agile – Organizing, synchronizing multiple teams setup Estimations, ROI, project lifecycle
* Effective Communication: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Ability to facilitate dialogue at the right level of detail for all members of the Agile team
* Decision-Making & Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment
* Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations
* Interpersonal Relationships: Knowledge of the techniques and the ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner. Ability to work seamlessly with business partners and software developers alike in a liaison role
* Financial Acumen: Knowledge of financial concepts, tools and processes and how financial metrics are used to monitor and drive outcomes. Includes understanding of company accounts/metrics (ex: balance sheet, profit/loss, cash flow, budget & forecast)
* Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems
* PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

title: UX Design Architect
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
We are looking for an experienced Senior UX/UI Designer who combines exceptional hands-on design expertise with solid leadership capabilities. You will lead complex design initiatives while actively contributing to research, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity interfaces, prototypes, and scalable design systems.
  
  
The ideal candidate has a proven track record of creating intuitive, engaging member experiences and transforming complex, large-scale data into clear, actionable interfaces. You will help shape product direction, raise design quality, mentor designers, and collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver measurable user and business outcomes.
  
  
This role also requires a forward-looking designer who responsibly applies AI-powered tools, automated workflows, and AI agents to accelerate design and delivery-while maintaining human judgment, data privacy, accessibility, and quality
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Hands-On Design Ownership: Lead end-to-end UX/UI design for complex digital products, from discovery and concept development through detailed interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and implementation review
* Design Leadership & Quality: Set a high standard for usability, visual craft, consistency, and accessibility. Lead design critiques, communicate actionable feedback, and ensure solutions meet user needs and business objectives
* Dashboard & Data Visualization Design: Create intuitive, data-rich dashboards and analytics experiences that help users interpret complex information, identify insights, and take action
* Member Experience: Design cohesive end-to-end journeys, personalized portals, and engagement features that build trust, simplify interactions, and support member retention
* Product Discovery & Strategy: Lead stakeholder workshops, research synthesis, journey mapping, and concept exploration to define problems, prioritize opportunities, and influence product roadmaps
* Figma & Design Systems: Lead the creation and evolution of scalable design systems, including reusable components, design tokens, responsive patterns, documentation, and developer-ready specifications
* AI-Enabled Workflows: Evaluate and apply AI tools and automation to support research synthesis, ideation, wireframing, prototyping, and documentation. Validate outputs and follow organizational privacy and security requirements
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, Architects, and business stakeholders across time zones to align priorities, resolve trade-offs, and support efficient delivery
* User-Centered & Accessible Design: Champion research-informed decisions, inclusive design, and WCAG-aligned accessibility throughout the product lifecycle
* Mentorship & Team Development: Mentor designers through hands-on guidance, thoughtful feedback, and knowledge sharing to strengthen individual capabilities and overall team quality
* Design Validation & Outcomes: Use usability testing, product analytics, and user feedback to evaluate solutions and improve adoption, task success, engagement, and satisfaction

title: Founder's Office - AI Implementation
description:
**Company Description**

NextDimension AI is building the operating system for specialty medicine. We deploy autonomous AI agents that handle the full scope of patient operations — scheduling, care coordination, billing, and more — so practices can run leaner and patients get a better experience.Our team comes from Google, Amazon, Nvidia, Adobe and Visa.We are rapidly growing and looking for builders who want to do the best work of their careers on problems that actually matter: Patient journey, Healthcare systems optimization, and a new AI-native Operating System for Health Systems.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram, working closely with the founders to drive product delivery across key customer implementations.

You’ll own what happens after a customer signs — getting them live, keeping them healthy, and helping them grow.

**Run the implementations**

* Own the plan and timeline for every account you’re assigned — who’s doing what, by when, and what’s blocking it
* Juggle several implementations at once and always know where each one stands
* Chase down client-side blockers and unblock

**Onboard new customers with Quality**

* Run onboarding start to finish — kickoff, setup, configuration with the engineers, testing, and go-live
* Be the customer’s main point of contact the whole way through
* Make sure every deployment is actually set up right before it goes live — quality, not just hitting the date

**Keep accounts healthy and growing**

* Watch the numbers that matter once a customer is live — adoption, resolution rate, AI-booked appointments, prior-auth automation, patient satisfaction
* Run regular check-ins and act as the early warning system the moment an account goes quiet
* Spot the opening to expand when an account is doing well and hand a warm, well-prepped expansion roadmap to customers

**Build the playbook**

* Turn what works into reusable SOPs, templates, and checklists as you go, organized by customer type
* Make each new customer an activation, not a project you start from scratch
* Set it up so all teams involved know what is next, and time to delivery keeps going down

**Who You Are**

You’ve done this before — carried customers from signed to live to growing, and you’ve done it for more than one at a time without losing the thread.

**You’ll need:**

* 3 to 6 years in hands-on, customer-facing delivery — implementation, onboarding, customer success, professional services, technical account management, or project management — ideally in B2B SaaS, AI, or healthtech
* A real track record running several implementations or accounts in parallel, on a timeline, and driving people to go-live
* Proof you’ve owned a deployment end to end yourself, from kickoff to adoption — not managing a relationship while someone else did the work
* Finisher energy — you go after the boring blocker and close the loop, every time
* Comfort with US-overlap hours for customer calls

**Strong plus:**

* You know US healthcare workflows or EHR/PMS systems or you’ve worked in RCM or practice operations
* You’re AI-native — you already use AI tools to automate your own work and you get what agentic systems can and can’t do

**What to expect**

* Location: Gurugram, India — 5 days in-office, 1 day work from home.
* Enterprise products shipped at startup speed.
* Salary + Bonus + Equity

Ready to build in the next dimension? We're not looking for someone to maintain a project. We're looking for someone to define the future of patient & practice experiences. Apply to join our mission!

title: Lead Quality Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
11
  
  
**The Role: Lead Quality Engineer**
**The Team**
Enterprise Solutions (ES) Technology brings together data, software, services, and expertise to deliver innovative solutions for global financial markets. The team works closely with customers to help them manage complex business, regulatory, and risk requirements.
  
  
Financial Risk Analytics (FRA), part of Enterprise Solutions, delivers information-centric capital markets and risk solutions for trading desks and their risk-management partners. Its products support counterparty credit risk, xVA, and market risk for both buy-side and sell-side institutions.
  
  
We are seeking a Lead Quality Engineer to join the FRA Technology team. Quality Engineering is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle and spans application, analytics, data, integration, and platform layers. The successful candidate will help evolve QA from a primarily validation-focused function into a proactive, automation-first, engineering-led capability.
  
  
**The Impact**
As a Lead Quality Engineer, you will own and influence the quality strategy across the software delivery lifecycle—from requirements and solution design through development, release, and production support. You will partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Operations, and Customer Support teams to identify risks early, improve test coverage, increase release confidence, and promote shared accountability for quality.
  
  
This role requires strong technical expertise, a solid understanding of financial risk platforms, and the ability to lead quality initiatives across agile delivery teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own and continuously improve the quality strategy across the full software development lifecycle, embedding effective quality gates from requirements and design through release and production support.
* Shift quality engineering from defect detection to defect prevention by identifying risks, control gaps, and testability concerns early in the delivery process.
* Lead the design, development, and evolution of scalable automated test frameworks covering UI, API, data, integration, regression, and other relevant testing areas.
* Develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test suites based on software requirements, technical specifications, business workflows, and real-world customer usage.
* Drive risk-based testing for financial risk platforms, prioritising coverage for regulatory workflows, calculation accuracy, data integrity, security controls, system integration, and customer-critical journeys.
* Design and implement test automation using Java, Python, Selenium, Cucumber, Carina, and other appropriate technologies and frameworks.
* Establish and monitor quality engineering standards and metrics, including automation coverage, defect leakage, release readiness, test reliability, environment stability, and production incident feedback.
* Champion continuous testing within CI/CD pipelines by integrating reliable and efficient automated validation into build, deployment, and release processes.
* Improve release confidence and operational resilience by validating deployment readiness, rollback capability, observability, environment consistency, and applicable non-functional requirements.
* Lead quality governance for agile teams, ensuring that acceptance criteria, test evidence, sign-offs, and release risks are clearly documented, auditable, and decision-ready.
* Manage and support QA and UAT environments, build deployments, test data, test execution, release planning, and testing sign-off activities.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Operations, and Customer Support to resolve quality issues and strengthen end-to-end software reliability.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand business impact and translate workflow complexity and customer needs into effective test coverage.
* Use AI and modern engineering practices to improve QA productivity through intelligent test generation, defect analysis, regression optimisation, log analysis, and test data creation.
* Mentor QA engineers and influence developers to build quality into their work by promoting automation, code quality, testability, maintainability, and shared ownership.
* Perform gap analysis across application and platform test coverage and define remediation plans to address identified risks.
* Balance manual and automated testing based on delivery needs, while continuously moving toward automation-first and analytics-driven quality engineering.
* Act as a technical leader and subject-matter expert, proactively resolving issues, managing risks, and escalating concerns appropriately.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may also be considered.
* 10 plus years of work experience across software quality engineering and end-to-end testing activities, including experience in a technical leadership or lead QA capacity.
* Strong hands-on experience with automation and white-box testing using Java, Python, or both.
* Experience designing and maintaining test automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, Carina, or equivalent web-testing frameworks.
* Demonstrated experience with API and web services testing, including the development or use of API automation frameworks.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software testing principles, test design techniques, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases; knowledge of PL/SQL, NoSQL databases, and Linux/UNIX environments is desirable.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and working with build and deployment processes.
* Understanding of performance, integration, regression, data, security, and non-functional testing practices.
* Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex issues across application, data, and platform layers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present quality risks and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cross-functional and geographically distributed agile teams.
* Ability to operate independently, take ownership, influence engineering decisions, and drive quality improvements across the organisation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with capital markets, financial risk analytics, counterparty credit risk, xVA, market risk, or related financial services platforms.
* Experience testing calculation-intensive, data-intensive, or regulatory applications.
* Knowledge of cloud-deployed applications, containers, microservices, messaging platforms, and distributed systems.
* Experience applying AI-enabled tools and modern engineering practices to improve testing efficiency and quality outcomes.
* Experience establishing quality metrics, governance processes, and continuous improvement programmes for engineering teams.

BrightSense is building technology for the AI age. Its first product is Branly, an AI visibility platform.

How people discover brands has changed. More and more, they ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google's AI answers what to buy, and those answers name only a handful of brands. Branly shows a brand how often it appears in those answers, how it is described and which sources the engines rely on. Then it turns every gap into a specific fix the brand can act on.

Three things shape how we work:

* **Grounded in research.**
  AI search changes every week. We study how each engine finds, trusts and cites its sources, and we keep our methods in step with what the engines do today.
* **Signal over noise.**
  We start from the real questions buyers ask, in their own words. We run them repeatedly across every major engine and read the answers over time, so what we show is a pattern, not a one-off.
* **Customer first.**
  Our customers sit at the centre of everything we build. We learn their category, competitors and goals, then stay alongside them until the work shows up as growth.

**The role**

We are hiring an Intern in the Founder's Office to work directly with the founding team across growth, product, research and operations.

You will run projects end to end: launch campaigns, read user data, speak to customers, test product releases, research competitors and keep day-to-day work moving. Some projects will be planned. Others will come up because something needs fixing that day.

We are an AI-first team. AI is how we research, write, analyse and build, not an add-on. You will be expected to work the same way: hand the first pass to AI, check it properly, and spend your own time on judgement and the parts that need a human.

You will learn how the business works by working across it. We are looking for someone who asks good questions, figures things out and takes a task through to completion.

Full-time internship, 6 months. On-site, Gurgaon. Stipend: ₹30,000 to ₹50,000 a month. You will report to the founding team.

**What you will do**

* **AI-first execution.**
  Use AI tools as your default way of working across research, writing, analysis and reporting. Build simple, repeatable workflows the team can reuse, check every output before it goes anywhere, and share what saves time.
* **Growth and go-to-market.**
  Run outbound and paid experiments end to end: list building, copywriting, campaign execution and performance analysis. Track what works, recommend what to change and stop what does not.
* **User funnel.**
  Track the journey from sign-up to activation and paid conversion. Find where users drop off, investigate why and work with the team to close the gaps.
* **User communication and channels.**
  Write and send the messages that move users forward: onboarding emails, follow-ups, reminders, community posts and content. Own each piece from first draft to publishing, and measure how users respond.
* **Cohort and segment analysis.**
  Use tools such as PostHog, Mixpanel or similar to understand how different user groups behave. Spot patterns, explain what they mean and recommend what to do next.
* **Direct user feedback.**
  Call and message users to understand what is and is not working. Capture feedback in their own words and bring clear findings back to the founding team.
* **Product testing and improvement.**
  Test upcoming releases, catch bugs before customers do and document issues the team can act on. Turn user feedback and funnel gaps into specific product ideas.
* **Competitor and market research.**
  Research competitors and relevant tools. Understand their pricing, strengths and differentiators, and identify where Branly can do better.
* **Operations and urgent priorities.**
  Take ownership of work across vendors, spreadsheets, hiring pipelines, launches and other operational needs. Keep information organised, follow up with the right people and close open tasks.
* **Learn the product inside out.**
  Use Branly the way our customers do. Understand how brands show up in AI answers, so your work in growth, research and support is grounded in the product.

**Who you are**

* A student or recent graduate who wants hands-on experience building and running a business.
* You have taken ownership of something and finished it. This could be an internship project, a campus initiative, a side project or something you built yourself.
* AI-first by habit. You already use tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity every day, you have used them to get real work done, and you know when an answer needs checking.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and numbers. You can spot a pattern, investigate a drop-off and suggest a concrete fix.
* A clear writer who can put together an email, campaign message or research note that gets to the point.
* Comfortable calling or messaging users, customers and vendors directly to get feedback or move work forward.
* Curious about startups, B2B software and marketing. You take an interest in how products find users and turn them into customers.
* Organised enough to manage several tasks, keep people updated and follow through without repeated reminders.

**Bonus points**

* You have built something with AI: an automation, a custom GPT or Claude project, or a workflow that replaced manual work.
* Hands-on experience with PostHog, Mixpanel, Google Analytics or similar tools.
* You have run an email campaign, built an online community, created content or tested a paid campaign.
* Experience testing a product and documenting bugs clearly.
* You have built a side project, worked at a startup or helped run an online business.

**What it is like working with us**

* **Build in one of marketing's most in-demand categories.**
  More brands want to understand how AI talks about them. You will help build a product that answers that question.
* **Learn to work the AI-first way.**
  You will see how a small team uses AI to do the work of a much larger one, and you will leave with workflows and habits most teams are still figuring out.
* **High ownership, high visibility.**
  You will work side by side with the founders. Your work ships fast, and you will see what it changes.
* **A seat close to the decisions.**
  You will see how growth, product and operations connect, and help shape what the team does next.
* **Learn from founders who have scaled before.**
  You will work closely with a team that has led and grown operations across industries, and you will pick up how it is done.
* **Grow as fast as you learn.**
  As you show what you can handle, you will take on larger projects and more responsibility.

title: Clinical Trials Operations & Product Strategy Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Trialion AI is an AI-native eClinical suite built on a single continuous data model, unifying EDC, ePRO/eCOA, RTSM, eConsent, medical coding, and site CTMS into one product. Every module reads and writes the same records under a single immutable audit trail, eliminating system reconciliation, connector validation, and data migration during protocol amendments. The platform is designed for rapid study build, live deployment of amendments, and data quality at the point of entry, with AI-assisted workflows always overseen and approved by qualified clinical data professionals. Trialion AI is architected to meet global regulatory standards including 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, ICH E6(R3), CDSCO Schedule Y, and the DPDP Act 2023. Built by clinical data and engineering leaders from IQVIA, Vidia, and Aerial Borne, it serves agile CROs, mid-market biopharma, and medical device companies running trials across India and APAC.

**Role Description**
The Clinical Trials Operations & Product Strategy Consultant is a full-time, hybrid role based in Gurugram, with flexibility for partial work from home. This role focuses on shaping product strategy for Trialion’s eClinical platform while ensuring that clinical trial operations are efficient, compliant, and aligned with sponsor and CRO needs. Day-to-day responsibilities include translating trial workflows and regulatory requirements into product features, collaborating with product managers and engineers on study build and data lifecycle design, and conducting operational analyses to improve site and sponsor experiences. The consultant will engage with customers and internal stakeholders to gather feedback, prioritize product enhancements, and support the design and rollout of new modules and capabilities. The role also involves preparing documentation and operational playbooks, contributing to go-to-market activities, and supporting cross-functional teams in India and APAC.

**Qualifications**

* Strong product strategy and product management skills, with the ability to define vision, roadmap, and use cases for eClinical solutions.
* Excellent analytical skills and research capabilities to evaluate clinical operations, user needs, and market trends.
* Experience in product development within clinical trials or healthcare technology, including collaboration with engineering and design teams.
* Solid understanding of clinical trial operations, data management, and regulatory frameworks such as ICH-GCP and 21 CFR Part 11.
* Prior experience working with CROs, biopharma, or medical device organizations, ideally in India or APAC, US markets.
* Ability to communicate complex technical and operational concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.
* Demonstrated capability to work in a hybrid environment, managing onsite collaboration in Gurugram and remote responsibilities independently.

title: Associate-Delivery Management
description:
**Job Description**
The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed, by supporting the delivery and operations of technology capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, the team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for external customers and internal colleagues. It also encompasses product management for core enterprise platforms, as well as technology risk and information security; enterprise data governance and platforms; digital product and design; and enterprise AI platforms across American Express.
  
  
We provide technology delivery leadership that turns complex enterprise priorities into execution, connecting strategy, teams, dependencies and governance to deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
The Associate, Delivery Management supports the execution of complex, cross-functional technology initiatives across Project Diamond and Customer Trust. Reporting to the Director of Technology Delivery, this role works across Technology, Product, and Business teams to help move delivery forward—maintaining clear plans, surfacing risks and dependencies early, driving follow-through on commitments, and ensuring leaders have an accurate view of progress and areas requiring attention.
  
  
This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who is highly organized, curious, and comfortable working through ambiguity. The successful candidate will be able to get into the details of an issue, understand what is preventing progress, connect dependencies across teams, and translate complex technical discussions into clear actions and delivery implications.
  
  
The Associate will also use AI-enabled tools and automation to improve the speed, quality, and consistency of delivery management, reporting, documentation, and follow-through
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Execution:**

* Support day-to-day execution of technology initiatives across Project Diamond and Customer Trust, from planning through implementation.
* Develop and maintain integrated delivery plans, milestones, commitments, dependencies, and critical dates across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Track work through key delivery stages and maintain a clear view of what is complete, what remains, and what is required to reach the next milestone.
* Identify deviations from plan early, understand the underlying cause and delivery impact, and drive appropriate follow-up with accountable owners.
* Coordinate cross-team activities required to resolve blockers, close dependencies, and maintain delivery momentum.
* Support implementation readiness, including tracking required testing, approvals, sign-offs, deployment dependencies, contingency plans, and other exit criteria.
* Support change management when scope, timing, dependencies, or delivery assumptions change.

**Risk, Dependency & Decision Management**

* Maintain clear visibility into risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and actions across assigned initiatives.
* Go beyond documenting blockers by helping establish the path to resolution: what needs to happen, who owns it, by when, and when escalation is required.
* Identify upstream and downstream dependencies across applications, platforms, teams, and initiatives and assess their impact on delivery plans.
* Track open decisions and ensure unresolved items are surfaced to the appropriate decision-makers with the context needed to act.
* Escalate material risks and issues early, with a clear articulation of impact, actions underway, and leadership support required.
* Drive actions and commitments through closure and ensure outcomes are reflected in the overall delivery plan.

**Governance & Executive Communication**

* Facilitate working sessions, checkpoints, and governance forums focused on execution, decisions, risks, dependencies, and next steps.
* Prepare concise, fact-based status updates that clearly communicate what changed, what is at risk, the path forward, and where leadership intervention is required.
* Maintain accurate program-level reporting across milestones, delivery health, risks, dependencies, and commitments.
* Support Program Increment (PI) planning and PI closeout, including scope, commitments, carryover, dependencies, delivery forecasts, and outcomes.
* Help ensure governance forums are decision- and action-oriented rather than primarily status-reporting exercises.

**Technical & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Technology, Product, Business, and other delivery teams to understand execution plans and cross-functional dependencies.
* Participate in technical discussions involving APIs, application integrations, data flows, environments, testing, deployment, and system dependencies.
* Develop sufficient technical understanding to ask effective questions, identify delivery implications, and recognize when additional technical expertise or escalation is needed.
* Translate technical discussions into clear business and delivery terms, including decisions, actions, risks, dependencies, owners, and timing.
* Connect related issues across teams and workstreams to help identify potential downstream impacts before they affect delivery.

**AI-Enabled Delivery**

* Use AI-enabled tools to improve project tracking, meeting synthesis, status reporting, risk and action management, documentation, and follow-through.
* Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, completeness, appropriate context, and alignment with source information before use.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive delivery-management activities and improve the timeliness and consistency of program information.
* Help establish practical, responsible ways to incorporate AI into day-to-day delivery-management workflows.

**Qualifications**

* 5 Years of experience.
* Experience in technology delivery, program/project management, technology operations, or a related discipline.
* Strong organizational and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, priorities, dependencies, and stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to track complex work, identify gaps or risks, and drive actions through completion.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to move from a reported issue to an understanding of root cause, impact, and path to resolution.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, concise updates for different audiences, including senior leaders.
* Working knowledge of technology delivery concepts such as APIs, system integrations, data flows, testing environments, application dependencies, release management, and production implementation.
* Ability to work effectively across Technology, Product, and Business teams without relying solely on formal authority.
* High attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of broader program objectives and critical priorities.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities, dependencies, and delivery plans may change.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies, business processes, and AI-enabled tools.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: AI Deployment & Enablement Lead
description:
**Position Title:**
AI Deployment & Enablement Lead
  
  
**Position Type:**
Regular - Full-Time
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
43595
  
  
**Overview**
Our Digital Technology team's goal is to leverage technology and data to drive profitable growth, enhance customer experience, and further our purpose of celebrating real connections through delicious, planet-friendly food.
  
  
McCain has embarked on an ambitious digital transformation across our business, from Agriculture and Manufacturing to Commercial and Corporate Functions. As part of this transformation, we are making significant investments in digital capabilities, data, automation, and Artificial Intelligence (AI).
  
  
The AI Deployment & Enablement Lead plays a critical role in helping McCain realize value from AI investments by driving successful deployment, adoption, and business enablement of AI solutions across the enterprise. This role serves as the bridge between AI product teams, technology teams, business stakeholders, and end users to ensure AI capabilities are effectively implemented, embraced, and sustained.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong project execution, stakeholder management, change leadership, and business acumen to accelerate adoption of AI-powered solutions that improve productivity, decision making, employee experience, and business outcomes.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Reporting to the AI Deployment & Enablement Manager, the AI Deployment & Enablement Lead is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing the deployment and adoption of AI solutions across McCain.
  
  
This role partners closely with product owners, AI engineers, business teams, functional leaders, and change management partners to ensure AI capabilities are successfully launched, effectively utilized, and continuously improved. The role focuses on driving business readiness, user adoption, training, communications, stakeholder engagement, value realization, and operational enablement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilites**
**AI Deployment & Implementation**

* Lead deployment planning and execution for AI products, tools, and capabilities.
* Coordinate implementation activities across business, technology, and external partners.
* Ensure deployment plans are aligned to business priorities, timelines, and operational readiness requirements.
* Monitor implementation progress, risks, dependencies, and mitigation activities.
* Support pilot programs, proof-of-concepts, and scaled enterprise rollouts.

title: Analyst, TSG Product Management
description:
**Company Profile**
Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.
  
  
Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.
  
  
The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
  
  
**What Makes Us Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list since its founding in 2009.
  
  
Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Analyst, TSG Product Management, is assigned to one or a few products. The Analyst is responsible for responding to user inquiries and troubleshooting issues, performing routine updates, and validating changes through testing. This role gathers product insights by tracking key metrics, monitoring usage and adoption, and collecting user feedback through periodic surveys. The Analyst also scopes and drives smaller enhancement requests — translating business needs into clear requirements — while communicating effectively with business users, technical teams, and other stakeholders to ensure their needs are fulfilled.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities and % of time**
**Product Maintenance & Analytics (50%)**

* Supports existing enterprise analytics products (e.g., Power BI and Tableau) by responding to user inquiries and troubleshooting issues, investigating root cause and escalating to technical teams or platform specialists when required
* Independently makes complex manual updates based on incoming requests, applying sound judgment to optimize the product
* Runs periodic user surveys and forums to track satisfaction and identify areas for improvement
* Tracks and analyzes key metrics — including dashboards, usage, and adoption — summarizing insights and findings for stakeholders
* Tests routine updates and enhancements to validate functionality and ensure a user-friendly experience

**Manage Enhancement Requests (40%)**

* Elicits requirements on small-to-medium sized requests, working with users to translate use cases and pain points into underlying requirements and potential solutions
* Transforms these requests into actionable work via user stories, process flow diagrams, and other supporting documentation
* Works with appropriate technical teams and third parties to complete these items, prioritizing and communicating dependencies and tradeoffs with key stakeholders throughout

**Develop Domain Knowledge (10%)**

* Builds domain knowledge and a comprehensive understanding of relevant tools and platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Databricks or similar enterprise data platforms) to act more independently
* Stays up to date about emerging analytics technologies, including AI tools, to continuously improve ways of working

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to synthesize data, user feedback, and operational metrics into clear insights and recommended actions, and exhibit root-cause thinking
* Strong user support and troubleshooting skills; ability to respond to user inquiries, investigate issues, identify root causes, resolve where appropriate, and escalate effectively to technical teams or platform specialists
* Working knowledge of business intelligence and analytics concepts (e.g., dashboards/reporting, data access, user permissions, tool platform concepts, adoption, and common end-user workflows); familiarity with tools such as Power BI or Tableau; experience consuming data from Databricks or an enterprise data platform preferred
* Strong work management and organizational skills; ability to work from a backlog, coordinate multiple workstreams, track actions and dependencies, prioritize work, and communicate dependencies and tradeoff implications
* Ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements, including soliciting use cases, stakeholder requirements, and platform pain points
* Strong stakeholder communication skills; ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, platform administrators, vendors, and product leadership
* Strong written communication and documentation skills, including product documentation, status updates, process materials, user guidance, and executive-ready summaries
* Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging analytics technologies; ability to quickly learn new tools and evaluate capabilities; experience incorporating AI tools into day-to-day operations preferred

**Experience**

* Experience supporting technology products, analytics platforms, or business systems, ideally in a product management, product operations, business analyst, or similar role. Experience with business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau) and enterprise data platforms is preferred
* Experience with product maintenance and testing, including supporting routine updates and enhancements, validating functionality through testing, and assessing whether changes continue to meet user needs
* Experience working in a corporate environment
* Experience solving basic issues in software tools and turning findings into actionable next steps
* Experience supporting users or customers with clear and helpful communication.
* Experience with support platforms like ServiceNow is preferred

title: Global IT Platform Engineer Manager

We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

Delivering our clients unrivalled experience of exceptional service, value and flexibility is part of our DNA. We are looking for people who are passionate about Agile ways of working and want to spread this approach within our teams and business processes.
  
  
As we advance our digital transformation initiatives, we are looking for a Platform Engineer to lead multiple strategic projects. This role combines technical expertise with strategic leadership to oversee the development, configuration, and maintenance of our digital products, ensuring alignment with market trends and business needs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Leverage automation tools like Python, MS Forms, Workflows in Alteryx, and PowerShell to streamline processes and enhance operational efficiency.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, ServiceNow, Jira, and Trello.
* Strong teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a global team.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to listen actively and engage with stakeholders at all levels.
* Customer service orientation with a diverse group of stakeholders.
* Ability to balance customer needs with functional goals and objectives.
* Proficiency in cross-team collaboration to resolve challenges.
* Flexibility and adaptability to changing priorities based on customer needs.
* Experience coordinating and implementing digital solutions in a complex organizational environment.
* Hands-on experience with SaaS applications, including system configuration and integration.
* Experience working with cloud-based software and APIs.
* Working knowledge of security, access management, and data privacy for SaaS and AI solutions.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting to ensure reliable platform operations.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in a role supporting digital products, preferably in an analyst or engineering role.

Who You'll Work With
  
  

* Directly interact with the Director & Chapter Lead and peers within the Product Portfolio.
* Collaborate with every member of your squad, including Product Owners, Scrum Leads, Software Engineers, and QA Engineers, as well as internal customers and technical members from other Product Portfolios.

Additional info
  
  
**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Proactively monitoring and resolving issues, effectively communicating with key stakeholders and management.
* Leading with a strategic vision while managing technical challenges, ensuring detailed and effective execution.
* Identifying and solving non-routine problems independently, applying broad knowledge to troubleshoot system issues.
* Translating business needs into clear, actionable Agile user stories.
* Gaining a deep understanding of digital products to serve as a subject matter expert.
* Staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in the smart booking space to ensure our product portfolio aligns with market demands.
* Understanding IT architecture and effectively extracting and analyzing data across business systems.
* Organizing and presenting data to enable quick, informed decision-making.
* Prioritizing tasks and working independently, while communicating clearly across all levels of the organization.
* Managing multiple complex tasks with high-quality results within deadlines.
* Applying Agile methodologies and principles, including work estimation techniques.
* Quickly learning and adapting to new tools and technologies.

*be your best*

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Program Management Senior Specialist - Growth Lab - Email
description:
**Join Us!**
At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
  
  
Program Management Senior Specialist is the glue that keeps all the elements of an owned marketing channel campaign (i.e. email) project together. They are well organized project managers, excellent communicators, proactive problem solvers and technical subject matter experts well versed in growth marketing. They are the connective tissue between the business (product marketing managers), production project managers and development team. They ensure projects are well defined, and delivered on time and meet quality standards.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**

* Partner with product marketing managers (PMMs) in campaign ideation and intake document formulation

+ Collaborate with PMMs during the campaign ideation stage, gather technical requirements, confirm feasibility of ideated campaign features, define potential execution timeline and the intricacies of email personalization and complex logic.
+ Provide strategic input on growth best practices, segmentation, and user journey optimization to help achieve campaign business goals.
+ Act as a consultative partner, advising PMMs on how to translate business objectives into effective owned channel (i.e. email) strategies.
+ Guide the PMM through the Campaign Requirement Document creation, ensure the intake documents are completed and comprehensive for the production team.

* Project manage campaign development and deployment

+ Kick off and strategically manage campaign development with offshore production team, provide guidance and answers to production team during the production process, manage production timelines.
+ Prepare work orders for the production team and create project estimations for the PMM, managing the approval process for these estimates.
+ Coordinate with Data Specialists to ensure that data requirements and inputs are fully aligned with HTML development and production process, as well as be a strategic partner between Data Specialists and offshore production team.
+ Conduct thorough quality assurance (QA) reviews on all deliverables against client specifications before releasing to the PMM
+ Communicate production progress to PMM, facilitate approval of simulations, proofs and prototypes, ensure any changes are implemented after prototype and proof review.
+ Flag issues that arise during the production process and proactively seek solutions.

* Manage campaign deployment in Internal Growth tools, monitor campaign health

+ Actively manage the Internal growth tool (i.e..Gamma) campaign deployments and proactively manage the campaign lifecycle (pause, activate, launch Gamma campaigns). GAMMA is Google’s internal email marketing platform.
+ Be the expert on Gamma campaigns under their management.
+ Monitor campaign deployment health through Gamma reporting tools and internal tools. Where applicable, delegate monitoring to Data Specialists and email specialists acting as the accountable party for campaign health monitoring and error escalation.
+ Conduct post-launch campaign performance analysis to derive engagement insights and identify areas for future improvement.

* Troubleshoot and solve escalations

+ When issues arise on existing or newly deployed campaigns, proactively lead the resolution process by quickly identifying root causes, work closely with product marketing managers, production project managers, and the development team.
+ Document the issue in the form of a blameless post mortem, ensure alignment across stakeholders and facilitate process adjustments mitigating repetition of the issue in the future across the team.

* Keep things organized

+ Attend regular scrums and stand ups, provide updates on project status and act as a collaborative business partner to the PMM leading the scrum.
+ Effectively and proficiently communicate with the offshore production team by setting up and leading weekly calls. Maintain internal project status trackers and post launch quality control sheets.
+ Ensure accurate work progress tracking in Asana.

* Drive innovation and thrive for excellence
* Proactively look for ways to improve the process to drive efficiency and reduce risk such as through implementing AI tools in the email creative or production processes.

**Qualifications**
****Minimum Qualifications:****

* Overall 5+ years of experience in project management roles, coordinating projects across multiple organizations/cross functional teams.
* Complex Email Campaign Management: 2-3 years of proven ability to manage high-complexity, interdependent email campaigns, anticipating risks across multiple systems and stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment.
* Email Marketing Technology Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in primary email marketing technology tools (e.g., Marketo, Eloqua, Hubspot etc.) with the ability to learn and navigate independently across multiple platforms.
* Technical Proficiency (HTML): Basic understanding of web development, HTML/CSS & QA processes, with the ability to identify root causes, troubleshoot technical issues, and architect resilient solutions."
* Strategic Client Handling: Advanced client handling skills with a track record of acting as a strategic advisor, understanding scope and providing estimates that align with long-term business goals.
* Data Analysis: Proficiency in data analysis tools to interpret performance results and recommend strategic improvements to stakeholders.
* Communication: Strong, polished, and professional communication skills required for interacting with stakeholders and leading the production team.

**Preferred Qualifications**
****Preferred Qualifications:****

* Understanding of marketing operations, processes, business requirements.
* Proactive and curious attitude, strong problem solving skills.
* Familiarity using GenAI (generative AI) for email marketing content, production and optimization.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with rapidly changing priorities and a high volume of projects.

**Benefits**

* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

title: Senior Software Development Engineer L4
description:
**Who We Are**
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer L4, you are part of the Data Platform Engineering team, helping customers make smart, well informed decisions by harnessing diverse, well curated healthcare data at scale. You design and build full stack solutions that support data driven products and platform capabilities across modern cloud environments. In this role, you contribute to responsive user experiences, scalable backend services, and distributed systems that support the performance, reliability, and security of Inovalon’s data platform.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, develop, deploy, test, and support technical solutions using full stack development tools and technologies.
* Build user friendly, responsive web interfaces using modern web application frameworks and front end technologies.
* Develop backend services and application logic using Java, SQL, and Python, and build front end functionality using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Design and implement solutions using relational and NoSQL databases, with strong focus on scalable data access and performance.
* Deploy microservices using container orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, along with AWS managed services and related cloud tools.
* Troubleshoot complex distributed systems and resolve application and performance issues across the platform.
* Contribute to secure web application development by applying best practices in software design, implementation, and deployment.
* Support CI and CD pipelines and modern deployment techniques to improve software delivery and release reliability.
* Collaborate effectively with team members in a fast paced agile environment to deliver scalable platform solutions.
* Stay current with trends and technologies in backend and front end development and apply relevant improvements to engineering work.

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of experience in Enterprise Java development, and 3+ years of experience with JavaScript using modern UI frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.js.
* Bachelor of Technology, Master of Technology, Bachelor of Engineering, Master of Sciences, or Master of Computer Applications, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* Strong experience with Java, SQL, Python, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Expert level knowledge of RDBMS, SQL, and NoSQL database technologies.
* Demonstrated experience with caching, queuing, scheduling, concurrency, and event driven architectures.
* Demonstrated experience developing applications on or for Linux platforms.
* Proven track record implementing distributed systems, microservice architectures, and RESTful APIs.
* Strong experience with AWS preferred, and experience with Microsoft Azure, GCP, and/or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment techniques.
* Knowledge of best practices for implementing secure web applications.
* Demonstrate growth potential and learning agility by staying current with emerging backend, front end, cloud, and platform technologies, and applying new learning to improve engineering outcomes.
* Demonstrate leadership by collaborating effectively with cross functional partners, contributing technical expertise in agile environments, and helping move complex platform work forward across the team.
* Demonstrate adaptability by responding effectively to evolving requirements, changing priorities, and the demands of fast paced platform development.
* Demonstrate creative thinking by identifying practical solutions to distributed systems challenges, performance issues, and full stack design problems.
* Demonstrate analytical skills by troubleshooting complex technical issues, evaluating system behavior, and using evidence to make sound engineering decisions.
* Nice to have: Experience in data pipelines; experience with big data technologies such as Snowflake and Datastax.

Our Shared Commitments
  
  

* Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement;
* Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and
* Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer.

Work Environment
  
  

* This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.

*This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)*
*If you don’t meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
*By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth.*
*Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirement.*
